description: This file defines the class TableValuedFunction which implements various table-valued functions for Spark SQL, such as range, explode, inline, json_tuple, posexplode, stack, and others, providing an interface to create and manipulate table data within Spark.

classes.name: TableValuedFunction
classes.description: A class providing implementations for various table-valued functions in Spark SQL, utilizing a SparkSession to generate datasets based on different function calls.

methods.name: range(end: Long)
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of Longs from 0 to end-1.

methods.name: range(start: Long, end: Long)
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of Longs from start to end-1.

methods.name: range(start: Long, end: Long, step: Long)
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of Longs from start to end-1 with a specified step.

methods.name: range(start: Long, end: Long, step: Long, numPartitions: Int)
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of Longs with specified start, end, step, and number of partitions.

methods.name: fn(name: String, args: Seq[Column])
methods.description: Internal method to create a DataFrame by invoking a named function with arguments.

methods.name: explode(collection: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by exploding a collection column.

methods.name: explode_outer(collection: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by outer exploding a collection column.

methods.name: inline(input: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by inlining a column.

methods.name: inline_outer(input: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by outer inlining a column.

methods.name: json_tuple(input: Column, fields: Column*)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset from JSON fields in a column.

methods.name: posexplode(collection: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by positionally exploding a collection column.

methods.name: posexplode_outer(collection: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by outer positionally exploding a collection column.

methods.name: stack(n: Column, fields: Column*)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by stacking columns.

methods.name: sql_keywords()
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of SQL keywords.

methods.name: variant_explode(input: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by exploding a variant column.

methods.name: variant_explode_outer(input: Column)
methods.description: Creates a Dataset by outer exploding a variant column.

methods.name: python_worker_logs()
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of Python worker logs.
